Prep is EVERYTHING when it comes to retention and making your nails last 🙌🏽✨

• Lightly buff the shine from your nail tips—this helps the product grip better and prevents lifting
• Remove all dust after buffing (don’t skip this). Any leftover dust can cause peeling, lifting, and chipping
• Apply a dehydrator to remove oils so your base coat bonds properly

Now for the application 💅🏽

• Apply Beetles Base Coat and cure for 30–60 seconds depending on your lamp
• Go in with shade E461 as your base—apply 2 coats, curing in between for full coverage
• Add blooming gel (don’t cure yet 👀)
• Using E466, create your flowers
• Add 5 dots and let them bloom for about 10 seconds—once you love the look, cure
• Use E464 to finish detailing the flowers and cure again

To lock everything in 🔒✨

• Apply Beetles Top Coat, fully seal the nail, and cure for 60 seconds

This prep + process is what keeps your set looking fresh, glossy, and long-lasting 💖
